'''{{nihongo|Hozumi no Iwayumi|穂積磐弓}}''' was a figure from the late {{ill|Kofun period|en|Kofun period|qid=Q459939|lt=Kofun period|1=Kofun period}}. He held the {{ill|kabane|ja|カバネ|lt=kabane|lt_ja=姓}} of {{nihongo|''omi''|臣}}.

== Career ==
On the 4th day of the 7th month in the 16th year of the reign of {{ill|Emperor Kinmei|en|Emperor Kinmei|qid=Q329792|lt=Emperor Kinmei|1=Emperor Kinmei}}, Hozumi no Iwayumi, along with {{ill|Soga no Iname|en|Soga no Iname|qid=Q595897|lt=Soga no Iname|1=Soga no Iname}}, was dispatched to {{ill|Kibi Province|en|Kibi Province|qid=Q1155128|lt=Kibi Province|1=Kingdom of Kibi}} to establish the {{ill|Shirai no Miyake|ja|白猪屯倉|1=Shirai no Miyake|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shirai no Miyake|13=User:Immanuelle/Shirai no Miyake|qq=}} in five districts.<ref name="a">''{{ill|Nihon Shoki|ja|日本書紀}}'', Emperor Kinmei, Year 16 entry.</ref>
